summary: Financial researcher Jim Rickards claims a small company trading under $2 per share holds exclusive rights to a massive mineral deposit worth $2.7 trillion in gold, copper, silver, and critical metals. The project has been blocked by environmental regulations, but Rickards points to a June 30 deadline tied to pending Senate legislation and Executive Order 14153 as a potential catalyst for government approval and dramatic stock gains.

headline: Robbins LLP Reminds SLP Stockholders of its Investigation into Simulation Plus, Inc.; Contact the Firm for Information
summary: Shareholder rights law firm Robbins LLP is investigating Simulation Plus, Inc. (NASDAQ: SLP) for potential securities law violations and breach of fiduciary duties. The investigation follows significant stock declines triggered by disappointing revenue guidance in June 2025 (24% drop) and poor Q3 fiscal 2025 results including a $67.3 million net loss and $77.2 million impairment charge in July 2025 (26% drop). The company subsequently dismissed its auditor, Grant Thornton LLP, citing unresolved matters in segment reporting and internal controls.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company experienced significant stock price declines (24% and 26%) following disappointing financial guidance and results, reported substantial net losses and impairment charges, dismissed its auditor due to internal control issues, and is now subject to a shareholder investigation for potential securities violations and breach of fiduciary duties.

headline: BMI Class Action Notice: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline in Badger Meter, Inc. Class Action Lawsuit
summary: Robbins LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Badger Meter, Inc. (BMI) on behalf of investors who purchased stock between April 18, 2024 and April 16, 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 3, 2026.

headline: HELE Class Action Notice: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Helen of Troy Limited. Class Action Lawsuit

headline: Hengrui Pharma and Kailera Therapeutics Present Ribupatide Clinical Data at ADA 2026
summary: Hengrui Pharma and Kailera Therapeutics announced clinical trial results for ribupatide, a GLP-1/GIP receptor dual agonist in development as both an oral pill and weekly injection for obesity treatment. Phase 2 oral data showed mean weight loss of up to 12.1% with 38.6% of participants achieving 15% weight loss at 26 weeks, with low gastrointestinal side effects. Phase 1 injection data demonstrated similar safety and efficacy across Asian and non-Asian populations. Both companies plan to advance to Phase 3 trials, with global oral trials potentially starting in H1 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Positive clinical trial results showing strong weight loss efficacy (12.1% mean weight loss) with favorable safety profile and low GI adverse events. Company is advancing to Phase 3 trials in China, demonstrating progress in drug development pipeline.

Positive Phase 1 injection data showing consistent safety and efficacy across different populations, supporting advancement of global Phase 3 KaiNETIC program. Company is expanding ribupatide franchise with multiple formulations and additional pipeline candidates in development.

headline: Biomea Fusion Presents New Clinical and Translational Data for Icovamenib at the American Diabetes Association (“ADA”) 86th Scientific Sessions and Announces Expansion of Ongoing Phase I BMF-650 Study
summary: Biomea Fusion presented clinical and translational data for icovamenib at the ADA 86th Scientific Sessions, demonstrating improvements in HbA1c and C-peptide levels in type 1 and type 2 diabetes patients, along with potential benefits for muscle preservation and fat reduction. The company also expanded its Phase I BMF-650 study to evaluate rapid titration schedules for its oral GLP-1 receptor agonist candidate.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company presented promising clinical data showing meaningful improvements in glycemic control (1.8% HbA1c reduction) and endogenous insulin secretion in both T1D and T2D patients. Translational data demonstrated activation of beneficial metabolic pathways. The expansion of the Phase I study for BMF-650 with optimized dosing schedules indicates progress in pipeline development. No safety concerns were reported, and the data supports broader therapeutic applications beyond diabetes.

author: Mannkind Corporation
headline: Data at ADA 2026 Highlights Key Findings from Clinical and Real‑World Studies of MannKind’s Afrezza® (Inhaled Insulin) Across Pediatric Care, Pregnancy, and Use with Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) Systems
summary: MannKind announced new clinical and real-world data for Afrezza (inhaled insulin) presented at the ADA 2026 Scientific Sessions, following the FDA approval for pediatric use (ages 6+) in May 2026. Key findings include greater treatment satisfaction in pediatric patients, comparable efficacy to rapid-acting analogs, potential use with automated insulin delivery systems, and earlier pharmacodynamic effect completion. The company also reported positive real-world evidence on lung cancer risk and FUROSCIX benefits in heart failure patients.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company announced FDA approval for pediatric use of Afrezza, presented multiple positive clinical trial results showing efficacy and safety comparable to or better than alternatives, demonstrated treatment satisfaction benefits, and reported positive real-world evidence. The expansion into pediatric markets and growing clinical evidence base support positive momentum for the company's core product.
